coordinateEvidence.origin: The author caller stores zero-based genome-array index i and writes i+1 as the reported GCS coordinate. The trusted-site filter and score exporter retain the coordinate unchanged.
coordinateEvidence.pointConversion: start0 = reported GCSs_coordinate - 1; end0 = reported GCSs_coordinate. No additional shift is applied.
coordinateEvidence.sourcePointMeaning: The caller names i the left wall of the gap and compares normalized signal at array indices i and i+5. The displayed marker retains this source representative position. It is not shifted to a centre or expanded into a cut pair.
coordinateEvidence.strandConvention: The selected trusted-site tables provide coordinate, N3E and Score only. No per-site strand is supplied. The caller uses a combined end-signal track; the point layers remain unstranded.
coordinateEvidence.sequenceAnchorEvidence: The selected tables supply no site sequence or reference allele. Numeric placement is supported by the author code and declared modified reference, not independently validated per-site sequence anchors.
coordinateEvidence.referenceBinding: GEO names the mapped reference as W3110 MuSGS and supplies E_coli_w3110_G_Mu.fasta. The caller uses the same FASTA basename; the supplied FASTA header and exact sequence hash define this target.
coordinateEvidence.confidence: high for source-declared array-origin conversion and preservation; independent per-site sequence anchoring is unavailable

measurementMeaning.n3e: Published trusted-site normalized signal. The caller uses the minimum normalized signal at the paired i and i+5 positions; the trusted-site stage retains sites supported in at least two biological replicates and averages their positive supporting signals. It is not a raw read count. The combined trusted-site tables do not supply individual replicate measurements.
measurementMeaning.normalization: Author code adds a pseudocount, scales tracks by library size and divides treated IP signal by a smoothed untreated IP track. Values are preserved directly from the final trusted-site tables; no normalization is rerun.
measurementMeaning.motifScore: Published motif score. The score exporter preserves coordinate and N3E and adds the mean of score-array values at p-1+1 and p-1+4 for reported position p. This score is not treated as a probability or binding affinity.

sampleProvenance.conditionSpecificity: Each layer contains the published trusted-site summary for that treatment, not untreated gyrase activity.

missingness.conditionTables: Only published trusted-site calls are represented in each condition layer. Absence from another condition table is an unreported call, not an observed zero. No union matrix, absent-condition zero filling or added genomic rows is performed.
missingness.numericCells: All selected N3E and Score cells are present finite values. Any absent numeric cell would remain empty rather than becoming zero.
missingness.sourceReplication: Individual replicate values and unsupported replicate calls cannot be recovered from the supplied condition summaries and are not fabricated.

limits: A 500 kb subset of the author reference, not the entire chromosome.
Cleavage trapping depends on the drug treatment; this is not an untreated activity map.
The motif score is not a binding affinity or a probability.
The point coordinate denotes the source caller representative position; no strand, cleavage centre or second-cut position is asserted.
Per-site sequence anchors are not supplied by these tables.
The native converter emits linear topology although source FASTA/GFF does not declare topology.
The exact author modified reference is used; ordinary NC_007779.1 and MG1655 are not substituted.
The native converter lowercases every base. Author soft-mask capitalization is preserved in the authoritative originals only.
